Background: "Service Order 5 was initially approved by UTA's Board on December 20, 2023, to renew services to Southern Salt Lake and Southern Davis Counties, and later amended on April 17, 2024, to include fuel costs" (p.162-163). Contract Summary: "Service Order 5 Only: $22,729,653 [existing] -> $23,130,090 [new]; Total Existing Contract Value: $55,603,305 -> New Total Contract Value: $56,003,742; Amendment Amount: $400,437 (Service Order 5, Amendment 2)" (p.163) [total_value_usd here uses the Service-Order-5-only new cumulative total of $23,130,090; the $400,437 increment is explicitly a 12-month (Jan-Dec 2025) figure, recorded as annual_value_usd; overall MSA-wide new total across all service orders is $56,003,742 -- see companion MSA-ceiling and SO8 rows from a different UTA packet, not duplicated here]. "ridership increasing 63% in South Davis County and 37% in Southern Salt Lake County from January to October 2024"; amendment "includes adding two vans to the Southern Salt Lake County zone and one van to the South Davis County zone" (p.162-163). Fiscal: "approved 2025 UTA operating budget allocates $1,710,000 to the South Davis zone and $5,928,000 to the Southern Salt Lake County zone... $284,105 to be allocated to the Southern Salt Lake County zone and $116,332 to be allocated to the South Davis zone" (p.163-164). Entity: River North Transit, LLC (Via), signed by Alex Lavoie, Manager, dated 12/17/2024 on the amendment itself (p.167), ahead of the Feb 12, 2025 Board memo. Same packet also includes an unrelated Mott MacDonald, LLC Vehicle Program Management Consulting contract modification (NTE increase to $2,350,000/year) -- not Via, not recorded as a row.
